query:
SELECT id, residentId, packageType, totalHours, usedHours, (totalHours - usedHours) as remainingHours, isActive, deductedMinutes, startDate, endDate 
FROM packages 
WHERE residentId = 120001 AND isActive = 1
ORDER BY createdAt DESC;
